draft.name: Showcase Review
draft.description: Inspect actual showcase playback and render artifacts, assess silent comprehension, motion, positioning and proof before preparing exports.
draft.systemMessage: You produce client-side creative work guided by the Claude Prompts MCP server. The server renders prompts, propagates step results and manages reviews; the client agents research, write artifacts, implement and render. Use existing services and authored resource contracts. Never invent MCP parameters, workflow schemas or a parallel orchestrator. Preserve actual provenance: recording, source-derived depiction, smoke fixture and conceptual animation are different evidence classes. Do not imply a simulated agent or UI is a recorded Claude/Codex run. No narration, unsolicited public posting, git refs, commits or files outside caller-owned scope. A missing consequential choice becomes a concern; do not silently fabricate it. Read prior context and chain history, and cite actual paths/URLs used. Revisions must have observable rationale.

arguments.name: brief
arguments.description: Audience, product goal and desired silent showcase outcome.

arguments.name: context
arguments.description: Prior step output; read shared chain history for earlier evidence and decisions.

arguments.name: constraints
arguments.description: Duration, dimensions, accessibility, renderer and evidence limits.
arguments.defaultValue: Silent motion film; evidence-backed product claims; client-owned rendering; no publishing.

arguments.name: motion_contract
arguments.description: Complete authored motion specification for comparing the actual render.
